design_principles.zero_unlimited_events: No plan (including Enterprise) grants unlimited (-1) or non-numeric ("Custom") event, log, metric, trace, replay, profile, or AI quotas. Every plan has a concrete, finite numeric baseline. Custom Enterprise volume commitments are applied via organization_entitlement_overrides or stackable capacity add-ons.
design_principles.dual_layer_event_quotas: Combines a generic pooled monthly credit budget (quota.monthly_events) with explicit per-signal monthly event quotas (errors, logs, metrics, traces/spans, requests, replays, profiles, cron check-ins) so noisy signals (logs/replays) can never starve critical signals (errors/uptime).
design_principles.strict_free_tier_hard_limits: The Free ($0) plan enforces strict hard_limit across all quotas with zero overage billing, preventing uncollectible invoice generation on accounts without a payment method.
design_principles.complete_dependency_coherence: Every feature enabled on a plan has positive (>0) supporting quotas, and every disabled feature has 0 for its dependent quotas.
design_principles.sdk_handshake_always_permitted: Baseline SDK initialization (/v1/init), retry, and basic batching are enabled on all plans (including Free) so SDKs never fail with 403 on startup; higher tiers unlock dynamic remote config overrides and larger queues.

free.v2_problem: Non-zero quota (10/day) configured while parent alerting.enabled is false.
free.v3_resolution: Set quota.daily_alerts = 0 on Free (or enable basic email alerting if desired).

free.v2_problem: Non-zero quota (100/mo) and paid overage rate attached to Free plan while alerting.enabled is false and Free orgs have no payment method.
free.v3_resolution: Set quota.monthly_alerts = 0 and enforcement_type = hard_limit (no overage) on Free.

free.v2_problem: Overage rate ($0.25/100) configured on a 0 quota on the $0 Free plan.
free.v3_resolution: Removed overage from Free plan; set quota.connector_sends = 100 (hard_limit) for basic email connector notifications.

free.v2_problem: Free ($0) plan had paid overage configured ($0.50/1k credits) despite no Stripe payment method on file.
free.v3_resolution: Enforce strict hard_limit at 10,000 credits on Free; overage is only enabled on paid plans (Starter, Growth, Business, Enterprise).

free.v2_problem: quota.dashboards = 1 depends on dashboards.custom_dashboards, which is false on Free, causing DependencyGraph to disable the 1 dashboard quota at runtime.
free.v3_resolution: Changed quota.dashboards dependency to dashboards.enabled (true on Free) so Free orgs can use their 1 default dashboard.

free.v2_problem: sdk-config.module.ts throws 403 policy_violation on POST /v1/init when sdk.remote_config is false, breaking SDK initialization for Free tier projects.
free.v3_resolution: Enabled sdk.retry = true and sdk.batching = true (with quota.sdk_batch_queue_size = 100) on Free; allow baseline /v1/init delivery on all plans.

free.v2_problem: Used null for string feature support.sla.

starter.v2_problem: CRITICAL CONTRADICTION: profiling.enabled is TRUE on Starter, so Starter orgs ingest and pay credits for profiles, but quota.profile_retention_days is 0 days!
starter.v3_resolution: Set quota.profile_retention_days = 14 days on Starter (matching its entry-level paid tier).

starter.v2_problem: Set to 30 days on Starter even though security.audit_logs = false and security.enabled = false.
starter.v3_resolution: Set quota.audit_log_retention_days = 0 on Starter (since security.audit_logs is a Business/Enterprise feature).

starter.v2_problem: Set to 5 reports/mo on Starter even though dashboards.scheduled_reports = false.
Set to 2 service accounts on Starter even though security.enabled = false.
Used null for string feature support.sla.

growth.v2_problem: ObservabilityContextResolver (src/modules/observability/context.ts) uses legacy key "pro" instead of "growth".
growth.v3_resolution: Standardized on "growth" (90 days retention) and wired retention dynamically to catalog quotas.

growth.v2_problem: Set to 180 days on Growth even though security.audit_logs = false and security.enabled = false.
growth.v3_resolution: Enabled security.enabled = true and security.audit_logs = true on Growth (with 90 days audit log retention) OR set quota to 0. In v3, basic Audit Logs (30d) is unlocked on Growth.

growth.v2_problem: Set to 25 reports/mo on Growth even though dashboards.scheduled_reports = false.
growth.v3_resolution: Enabled dashboards.scheduled_reports = true on Growth so its 25 monthly_reports quota is actually usable.

growth.v2_problem: Set to 10 service accounts on Growth while security.enabled = false.
growth.v3_resolution: Enabled security.enabled = true on Growth so its 10 service accounts quota is active.

growth.v2_problem: Set to 25 custom roles on Growth while security.custom_roles = false.
growth.v3_resolution: Set quota.custom_roles = 0 on Growth (custom RBAC roles start on Business/Enterprise).

growth.v2_problem: Used null for string feature support.sla.
growth.v3_resolution: Normalized to explicit string "99.5%" (standard business-hours SLA) or "none".

business.v2_problem: Set to 100 custom roles on Business even though parent security.custom_roles = false!
business.v3_resolution: Enabled security.custom_roles = true on Business (with quota.custom_roles = 25) so Business customers can use custom RBAC roles.

business.v2_problem: ProvisioningRepository provisions all new signups onto Business 14-day trial, and BillingJobsRepository.expireTrials() pauses the org after 14 days instead of downgrading to Free.
business.v3_resolution: Either provision new orgs on Free (with optional self-serve 14-day trial of Growth/Business) or auto-downgrade expired trials to Free instead of pausing ingestion.

enterprise.v2_value: "Custom" (string in TS, NULL integer in SQL)
enterprise.v2_problem: CRITICAL: Storing string "Custom" in an integer quota causes BillingCatalogValidator to fail and EntitlementsService.getEffectiveIntegerFeature() to return 0 (blocking Enterprise ingestion). Setting it to -1 (unlimited) creates unbounded infrastructure cost exposure and breaks addon addition in EFFECTIVE_ENTITLEMENTS_SQL.
enterprise.v3_resolution: Replaced "Custom" / -1 with a concrete, finite baseline of 50,000,000 monthly credits (50M) on Enterprise, with contract_overridable = true via organization_entitlement_overrides and stackable events_10m add-ons.

enterprise.v2_problem: ObservabilityContextResolver hardcodes 400 days for Enterprise while catalog defines 365 days.
enterprise.v3_resolution: Standardized on 365 days across catalog and runtime.

enterprise.v2_value: trial_days=30, is_public=false in 004_11 vs trial_days=0, is_public=true in 032_17
enterprise.v3_resolution: Consolidated to single canonical definition (trial_days=30, is_public=false, sales-assisted/custom contract).

catalog_wide_structural_issues.title: 33 of 34 quotas allow unlimited (-1) via supportsUnlimited: true
catalog_wide_structural_issues.impact: Allows accidental unlimited resource provisioning and triggers SQL SUM(-1 + addon) corruption in EFFECTIVE_ENTITLEMENTS_SQL.
catalog_wide_structural_issues.resolution: Set supports_unlimited = false across all 34 quotas in v3; every plan tier uses finite integer limits.

catalog_wide_structural_issues.title: Missing generic per-signal event quotas (all telemetry shares one quota.monthly_events pool)
catalog_wide_structural_issues.impact: A spike in debug logs or session replays exhausts 100% of quota.monthly_events and causes IngestionService to drop production errors and cron check-ins.
catalog_wide_structural_issues.resolution: Added 8 explicit per-signal monthly event quotas alongside the pooled quota.monthly_events budget.

catalog_wide_structural_issues.title: Mismatch between SDK_EVENT_TYPES (10 signals) and billing_event_credit_weights (10 rows)
catalog_wide_structural_issues.impact: SDK_EVENT_TYPES has request, profile, cron_checkin, and message which are missing from billing_event_credit_weights (falling back to 1.0), while billing_event_credit_weights has crash, session, and ai_action which are not SDK_EVENT_TYPES.
catalog_wide_structural_issues.resolution: Aligned event_credit_weights 1-to-1 with all 10 canonical SDK_EVENT_TYPES (error, message, request, span, trace, metric, log, profile, cron_checkin, replay).

catalog_wide_structural_issues.title: Duplicate quota keys in FEATURE_REGISTRY (quota.alert_channels vs quota.notification_channels, quota.connectors vs quota.integrations)
catalog_wide_structural_issues.impact: Identical limits, scopes, and dependencies checked inconsistently across services.
catalog_wide_structural_issues.resolution: Marked quota.notification_channels (alias of quota.alert_channels) and quota.integrations (alias of quota.connectors) as deprecated aliases in v3.

catalog_wide_structural_issues.title: 62 of 102 catalog features have zero backend runtime enforcement
catalog_wide_structural_issues.impact: Features and quotas advertised in the plan matrix (e.g. quota.daily_alerts, quota.monthly_alerts, quota.connector_sends, quota.requests_per_second, quota.*_retention_days, privacy.*, dashboards.*, alerting.composite/escalation_policies/on_call) are not checked by backend services.
catalog_wide_structural_issues.resolution: Documented exact enforcement wiring targets for every feature in the v3 catalog.

catalog_wide_structural_issues.title: UsageRollup crashes on fractional weighted credits ($3::bigint[] cast of decimal totals)
catalog_wide_structural_issues.impact: Ingesting logs (0.2 weight) or metrics (0.1 weight) produces non-integer totals in UsageRollup.run(), failing BULK_DAILY_UPSERT_SQL ($3::bigint[]) and rolling back billing usage updates.
catalog_wide_structural_issues.resolution: Round/ceil credit totals to integer credits before BIGINT array binding or store credits as NUMERIC(18,4).

telemetry_event_quotas_and_weights_v3.description: Enterprise-grade two-layer telemetry metering: (1) Pooled Monthly Telemetry Credits (quota.monthly_events) and (2) Explicit Generic Per-Signal Monthly Event Quotas so every signal has a predictable finite cap and cannot starve mission-critical error/uptime signals.

aligned_sdk_event_credit_weights.description: Metric data point (counter, gauge, histogram, summary)
Scheduled job / cron monitor heartbeat check-in
Captured application exception or error event with stacktrace
Continuous CPU or heap profiling sample payload
